Hi Johannes,
As we checked today, the error is coming from one of these sensors:
Unfortunately, by the time we got there, the error was no longer present. It's impossible that a temperature sensor would be reading 130ºC when the heater is not even turned on.

I will keep this ticket until tomorrow and if the problem doesn't persist, I will close the ticket.
Thank you!

additional_info.subject: ID0483248-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/SN170004283] sensor problem for DC1 CRM:02681001585
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
As you showed, the error was present 1h20 ago, but now it's no longer present again.
The only reason I see is that by moving the cable or twisting it, the temperature sensor is not working properly. The only way to know is by going there and measure the points that i send in the previous email.
I recommend you to take a spare H+S cable but we need to proof that it's the cable that is faulty.
I will send this ticket to RC-AT queue.
Best regards,
Francisco
